hypothesis: The existing directional score may complement NFI's entry logic even though its standalone tail gate failed. Inspect signed relative rank on the already executed archived fixed-boost NFI campaigns.
scope: 2026 discovery archived online-style FlatTopBoost 12-slot wallet, both 15 and 8 bp. The selected model and baseline are known; this is a retrospective attribution, not a replay of a modified wallet.
asof: For a trade opened on UTC day d, use the score observed at midnight d-1. The one-day delay matches the earlier score analysis. Score only historically available assets and preserve each missing case.
test: Use score ranks before inspecting each trade outcome. Long agrees at rank percentile at least .5; short agrees below .5, exact ties receive the same percentile. Include only native natural closes for payoff outcomes, preserving counts of terminal positions and missing scores. Report all and long/short separately and by UTC entry half-year.
outcomes: Native realized cash PnL excluding artificial terminal liquidation, counts of gains and losses at least 25 USDT, median and mean, and magnitude normalized by total filled margin. Opportunity counts are attributed to actual campaigns, not computed as a filtered portfolio or used to claim incremental NAV.
